segments.name: Betway
segments.description: Runs a premier single-brand online sportsbook and online casino for customers worldwide, supported by strategic partnerships with sports teams and leagues.
segments.evidence: Betway: Premier single brand online sportsbook and online casino focused business with a global footprint and strategic partnerships with teams and leagues worldwide.

segments.name: Spin
segments.description: Operates a multi-brand online casino portfolio serving customers globally, with a small amount of revenue also coming from sports betting.
segments.evidence: Online casino revenue is mainly generated by Spin (which consists of more than 16 separate brands collectively referred to as Spin), which also generates a small amount of revenue from sports betting.

revenueModel.text: Customers worldwide pay for online sports betting and casino gaming, and other gambling companies pay license fees to use the Betway brand.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue also includes brand licensing revenues generated by the provision of the Betway brand to other online gambling companies.

changes.text: In 2024 the DGC sportsbook was closed, so the Betway portion of DGC stopped contributing to the Betway segment.
changes.evidence: Following the closure of the DGC sportsbook in 2024, the Betway portion of DGC no longer contributed to this segment.

changes.text: In 2024 a gain on disposal of business was recognized on the sale of the business-to-business division of DGC.
changes.evidence: Gain on disposal of business in 2024 relates to the gain recognized on the sale of the B2B division of DGC.

changes.text: In 2025 the company changed the presentation of its segment disclosures.
changes.evidence: The Group has changed the presentation of its segment disclosures during the year ended December 31, 2025.
